title: Mandatory Self-Awareness Enforcement — Auto-Check PRISM Inventory Before All Internal Operations
description: Enforce that ALL requests to build, audit, or investigate internally MUST check PRISM inventory, master index, and utilize self-awareness + AI capabilities. No duplicate creation, no reinventing wheels.

units.title: PreToolUse Hook — Build/Create Detection
units.description: Hook that intercepts tool calls related to building/creating and triggers mandatory checks

units.title: Inventory Check Guard Hook
units.description: Reads BASELINE_INVENTORY.json and injects current counts before any build operation
deliverables: Warning if creating in saturated category
units.ship_notes: Hook at .claude/hooks/inventory-check-guard.mjs covers all 3 deliverables: reads BASELINE_INVENTORY.json + injects compact 1-line inventory + emits saturation warning when user prompt names a category whose count exceeds SATURATION_THRESHOLDS (engines>3000, dispatchers>100, actions>7500, algorithms>25, hooks>70, skills>500). Saturation detector covered by 17 vitest cases in inventoryCheckGuardSaturation.test.ts (input guards, threshold gating, word-boundary regex, defensive numeric coercion, structural invariants).

units.title: Master Index Search Gate Hook
